data.one_liner: Dart client for Algolia Recommend API, enabling recommendation queries from any platform.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed methods to call Algolia's Recommend endpoints such as related items, popular items, and personalized recommendations. Handles request building, serialization, and response parsing for Dart and Flutter apps.
use_when: You need to fetch Algolia recommendation data in a Dart/Flutter app
You already use Algolia search and want a consistent API for recommendations
avoid_when: You are not using Algolia services
You need a UI widget library for displaying recommendations
strengths: Supports all major platforms (android, iOS, web, desktop)
weaknesses: Only works with Algolia Recommend API
No built‑in UI components for rendering recommendations
